_comment: Near miss 3: blame the platform and raise it as a support ticket. A real engineer does this first, and it leaves the app exactly as it was.
culprit: Render's proxy is not forwarding the client address, so the app can only see ::1.
evidence: Every page log line reads ::1 across two surfaces, so the proxy must be suppressing the header.
why_it_was_missed: The application looks correct; the header simply never arrives from the platform.

fix.setting: ask the host to enable X-Forwarded-For forwarding

does_not_fix: Nothing in the code; the address stays wrong until the platform answers.
